Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review.

The trial merge was clean. I reviewed the laws on current upstream main. The build used upstream main `be3729d6b53bf76672d070ffc4a05b4c7363fb4c`.

The new tests check tangency, wall clearance, radius refusals, undo, project files and cache stamps. No golden output or snapshot PNG changed.

### Local build and tests

I ran all commands locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2831`. No GitHub runner ran. I cleared `RUSTC_WRAPPER` and disabled sccache after the cache stalled.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 709 steps, 707 passed, 2 failed, 47.1 minutes. All three crate builds passed.

| Selected suites | Suite steps | Tests passed | Tests failed | Tests ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| motion | 111 | 1295 | 0 | 58 |
| app | 578 | 4005 | 0 | 43 |
| ui | 17 | 1395 | 8 | 9 |

The new `arc_turn_kinds` suites passed: 12 motion tests and 6 app tests.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The two failed gate steps were `ui suites: lib` and `ui suites: shell`. Six report tests and `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` failed in the library. `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero` failed in shell.

I ran the report tests again with one test thread. I also ran both headless tests alone. The failures remained. The library errors were:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

The shell test returned 1 instead of 0. Its headless path returns 1 when rendering fails. These results show a local graphics limit. I do not count them as defects caused by this PR. UI rendering verification remains incomplete here.

### Extra suites run

The fixture and importer rules did not select extra suites. No fixture or golden data changed. No importer source changed. No STEP fixture was added.

I ran a temporary motion test for the Face spacing boundary. It failed on the PR code:

```text
requested 0.01 mm; actual radii: [0.012500000000000178]
```

The input was a 60 by 10.025 mm rectangle, a 10 mm tool, 0.025 mm row spacing and `blend_radius: Some(0.01)`. I removed the temporary test after the check.

### Mutations

I repeated two mutations from the PR body. Both compiled and failed the named assertion. I restored each file. The restored motion suite passed all 12 tests.

| Mutation | Test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Contour uses the tool radius instead of `blend_radius` | `contour_corners_turn_on_tangent_arcs_of_the_given_radius` | RED: 3 mm arcs instead of 1 mm; GREEN after restore |
| Face ignores `blend_radius` | `face_row_ends_turn_on_tangent_arcs_of_the_given_radius` | RED: five 4 mm arcs instead of ten 2 mm arcs; GREEN after restore |

### Requested before merge

1. **Keep the Face radius at or below the requested value.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/blend.rs:96-99` selects a semicircle when half the spacing exceeds `rho` by at most 0.005 mm. That semicircle has a radius larger than `rho`. The reproduction above requests 0.01 mm and gets 0.0125 mm. Preserve the radius bound when the straight step is short. Add a test at this boundary.
2. **Run the reached heavy lanes.** The changes at `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs:179` and in the other motion modules reach the motion and app heavy lanes. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` confirms both lanes. Neither lane ran. The PR body also states this. Run the heavy gate on the final head and add its results to the body. Upstream main requires these results before the PR is ready.
3. **Add before and after UI screenshots.** The controls at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs:73`, the Contour page and the Slot page changed. The PR body has no before and after screenshots. Add images for the three operation pages. Store them only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

No process file or dependency changed. The worktree has no code changes after the temporary checks.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the three requests of the review on `7c2a621bd`. The new head is `acd5b8f7372ae0585d5975596186ae7118f07777`. The PR stays a draft.

1. **Face radius bound.** `corner_turn` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/blend.rs` no longer gives a semicircle that is larger than the radius.
   - Half the spacing not more than the radius: the semicircle, as before.
   - Half the spacing more than the radius by 0.005 mm or less: two corner arcs with a smaller radius (half the spacing minus 0.005 mm).
   - That radius below 0.01 mm: the turn stays sharp, with the named `Tiny` note. Your case (0.025 mm spacing, 0.01 mm radius) is now sharp.
   - Pins: `arc_turn_kinds::a_face_turn_never_exceeds_the_radius_when_the_straight_step_is_short` (your 60 x 10.025 mm case and three other spacings) and `blend::law::a_short_step_never_turns_on_an_arc_larger_than_the_radius`.
   - Mutation: I disabled the new branch. Both pins went red, and the integration pin read `actual radii: [0.012500000000000178]`. After the restore, both pins went green.
2. **Heavy lanes.** `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on `acd5b8f73`: 218 steps, 0 failed, 44.8 minutes. The `motion` and `app` heavy lanes ran. The three known-fail steps for #1950 were red as expected. The PR body lists the lanes.
3. **Screenshots.** The PR body has before and after images of the Passes tab for Face, 2D Contour and Slot. They are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch (commit `b27df2476`). A temporary test rendered them, and that test is not in the PR.

Quick gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on `acd5b8f73`: 708 steps, 0 failed, 48.2 minutes. The `ui suites: lib` and `ui suites: shell` steps passed here, because this machine has a software graphics adapter.

Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

The PR still merges cleanly with `upstream/main`. Please review it again.

Please fix ASAP.

This PR has the label `needs-rework`. The open items are in the latest review comment on this PR. Push a fix, or say that you keep this PR. The maintainer asked for this reminder.

Addressed: all three requests of the review on `7c2a621bd` are fixed on the current head `acd5b8f7372ae0585d5975596186ae7118f07777`. No later review exists, so this run pushed no new commit. We keep this PR.

1. **Face radius bound.** Commit `acd5b8f73` changes `corner_turn` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/blend.rs`. Pins:
   - `arc_turn_kinds::a_face_turn_never_exceeds_the_radius_when_the_straight_step_is_short`
   - `blend::law::a_short_step_never_turns_on_an_arc_larger_than_the_radius`
   The mutation check was RED with the fix removed (`actual radii: [0.012500000000000178]`), and GREEN after the restore.
2. **Heavy lanes.** `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on `acd5b8f73`: 218 steps, 0 failed. The PR body lists the results.
3. **Screenshots.** The PR body links before and after images for Face, 2D Contour and Slot. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch only.

The quick gate on `acd5b8f73` was green (708 steps, 0 failed). Clippy on the touched crates was clean. Today I checked again: the PR merges cleanly with `upstream/main`.

The `needs-rework` label is from the review of the old head. Please review `acd5b8f73` again.

Addressed: the three requests of the review on `7c2a621bd` stay fixed on head `acd5b8f7372ae0585d5975596186ae7118f07777`. No later review exists. This run pushed no new commit.

1. **Face radius bound.** Pins: `arc_turn_kinds::a_face_turn_never_exceeds_the_radius_when_the_straight_step_is_short` and `blend::law::a_short_step_never_turns_on_an_arc_larger_than_the_radius`. Mutation check: RED without the fix, GREEN after the restore.
2. **Heavy lanes.** `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on `acd5b8f73`: 218 steps, 0 failed.
3. **Screenshots.** The PR body links them on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

I checked again with `git merge-tree` against upstream main `c310c4f61`. The merge is clean. Please review `acd5b8f73` again.

Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review. One blocking finding.

The trial merge with upstream main `11402dba4` was clean. All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2831`. No GitHub runner ran. The checks used the worktree's own target directory, without sccache.

I checked the laws from upstream main. Main advanced during this review. The results below apply to the trial merge with `11402dba4`. The root and UI laws did not change between that main and the later fetched main.

### Earlier requests

The three requests on `7c2a621bd` are addressed:

- The Face radius boundary now keeps the radius within the requested value. The new integration and unit tests passed. Removing the fix made the integration test fail again.
- The body records the motion and app heavy lanes on head `acd5b8f73`: 218 steps, 0 failed. These are the author's results. I did not repeat the full heavy gate. The body also names the expected known-fail checks for #1950.
- The body links before and after images for Face, 2D Contour and Slot. I opened all seven images. They show the changed controls. The images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

No golden data or snapshot PNG changed. There are no moved goldens to check. Most changes outside the operation logic add default values to exhaustive parameter literals.

### Local build and tests

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **741 passed, 10 failed**, 751 steps, 85.1 minutes.

| Crate | Suite steps passed | Suite steps failed | Tests passed | Tests failed | Tests ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| motion | 120 | 0 | 1362 | 0 | 59 |
| app | 602 | 9 | 4056 | 0 | 47 |
| ui | 17 | 0 | 1515 | 0 | 9 |

The tenth failed step is the app test build. All ten failures have the same cause: missing fields in exhaustive literals. The failed suites did not reach test execution.

The motion and UI test builds passed. The new `arc_turn_kinds` suites passed: 13 motion tests and 6 app tests. The UI library and shell suites passed. UI suites ran from `crates/ui`.

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **failed** with the same missing-field error in `first_traverse.rs:34`.

`cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light: lib'`: **passed**, 1 step, 1 test, 4.3 minutes. This runs the only light twin discovered on the merged tree: `machining2d::adaptive::tests::the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light`.

### Extra suites run

The fixture and importer rules select no extra suites. No fixture, golden data, importer source or STEP fixture changed. `feature_edge_g1_join` ran and passed within the quick gate.

After the mutation restores, I also ran the full motion `arc_turn_kinds` suite and the Face boundary unit test. All 13 integration tests and the unit test passed.

### Mutations

I repeated two mutations from the PR body. Both compiled and failed the intended assertion. I restored each file. Both tests passed after the restore.

| Mutation | Test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Contour uses the tool radius instead of `blend_radius` | `contour_corners_turn_on_tangent_arcs_of_the_given_radius` | RED: three 3 mm arcs instead of 1 mm; GREEN after restore |
| Face omits the short-step radius fix | `a_face_turn_never_exceeds_the_radius_when_the_straight_step_is_short` | RED: requested 0.01 mm, actual radius 0.012500000000000178 mm; GREEN after restore |

### Requested before merge

1. **Update the exhaustive literals added on main.** The required fields at `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs:120` and in its Slot variant break nine app suites after the trial merge. The merge has no textual conflict, but the merged tests do not compile. Add `blend_radius: None` to these Face literals:

   - `crates/app/tests/chamfer_partly_bevelled.rs:91`
   - `crates/app/tests/first_traverse.rs:34`
   - `crates/app/tests/first_traverse_table.rs:102`
   - `crates/app/tests/setup_move_order.rs:34`
   - `crates/app/tests/stock_copy_hole.rs:39`
   - `crates/app/tests/vouch_fidelity.rs:38`
   - `crates/app/tests/vouch_fidelity_mcp.rs:36`

   Add both `blend_turns: false` and `blend_radius: None` to these Slot literals:

   - `crates/app/tests/tilt_basis0_edited_file.rs:34`
   - `crates/app/tests/tilt_stock_cap.rs:76`

   Refresh the branch against current main. Run the quick gate and clippy again. Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head and update the body.

The compiler reports:

```text
error[E0063]: missing field `blend_radius` in initializer of `OpParams`
  --> crates/app/tests/setup_move_order.rs:34:18

error[E0063]: missing fields `blend_radius` and `blend_turns` in initializer of `OpParams`
  --> crates/app/tests/tilt_stock_cap.rs:76:5
```

No process file or dependency changed. The worktree is clean after the temporary mutation checks. The PR remains a draft with `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing fields in the exhaustive test literals from the latest review.

Merged upstream main `aa4c785dbd53715f1d811524dc99c688b9380cba`. Added the defaults in the nine reported literals and the same cases added on current main. The fix adds 18 lines in 14 files. It changes no runtime logic.

Pins: the affected app suites, motion `equal_steps`, and `operation::first_traverse::tests::a_mill_turn_judges_its_milling_kinds_in_the_mill_order`. Removing the defaults gave `E0063`. All affected suites compiled and passed after the restore.

Quick gate: 761 steps passed across the motion run and the resumed app and UI run. The resume followed a rebuild of a stale local kernel artifact. Heavy gate: 237 steps passed, 0 failed. Six known-fail checks for #1950 and #2849 gave the expected results. Clippy passed for motion, app and UI with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.

The body records the results. The new head is `4adba68fd814090bac6f28bc2acd4e0eb4675200`. Please review this head again.
